wins.text: Total revenue grew 39% YoY to $884M, exceeding the high end of prior guidance by ~350 bps and representing an 1,800 bps acceleration vs. Q1 2024 growth rate
U.S. commercial revenue grew 71% YoY and 19% sequentially to $255M, surpassing $1B annual run rate for the first time; U.S. commercial TCV booked hit $810M, up 183% YoY
Adjusted operating margin expanded 800 bps YoY to 44%, driving Rule of 40 score of 83 — 7th consecutive quarter of expansion; adjusted free cash flow of $370M at a 42% margin
U.S. government revenue grew 45% YoY and 9% sequentially to $373M; international government grew 45% YoY including new NATO Maven Smart System partnership across 32 member states
Total TCV booked of $1.5B, up 66% YoY; total remaining deal value of $5.97B, up 45% YoY; net dollar retention increased 400 bps sequentially to 124%

risks.text: International commercial revenue declined 5% YoY and 11% sequentially to $141M, driven by continued headwinds in Europe and a one-time Q4 2024 revenue catch-up; Alex noted 'Europe doesn't get AI yet'
U.S. DoD budget cuts and DOGE-driven federal spending reductions create potential lumpiness in government contract awards and renewals, even if management views it as net positive

Adjusted operating expenses grew 21% YoY and 8% sequentially to $493M as the company continues to invest heavily in technical hiring and AIP, with management flagging 'more significant increase in expense in 2025'
Stock-based compensation of $155M plus $59M in employee-related equity tax expense remain elevated, creating a significant gap between GAAP ($0.08 EPS) and adjusted ($0.13 EPS) earnings
Customer concentration risk: trailing 12-month revenue from top 20 customers grew only 26% YoY to $70M per customer, lagging overall growth rates and suggesting heavy reliance on a small cohort

guidance_items.detail: FY 2025 revenue raised to $3.89B–$3.902B (midpoint ~$3.896B), representing ~36% YoY growth; Q2 2025 guided to $934M–$938M
U.S. commercial revenue guidance raised to excess of $1.178B, representing at least 68% YoY growth
Adjusted income from operations raised to $1.711B–$1.723B for FY 2025; Q2 guided to $401M–$405M
Adjusted free cash flow guidance raised to $1.6B–$1.8B for FY 2025; Rule of 40 score guided to 80 for full year
Company continues to expect GAAP operating income and net income in each quarter of 2025

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Impact of U.S. DoD budget cuts and DOGE federal spending reductions on existing and future government contracts
European defense rearmament buildup as a potential growth opportunity for Warp Speed/manufacturing OS
Expansion of software-first hardware programs beyond TITAN (e.g., Golden Dome, space communications)
